title: District of Columbia v. Heller
publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
description: The individual right to possess a handgun for self-defense in the home, with majority and dissenting opinions.

title: McDonald v. City of Chicago
publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
description: Application of the Second Amendment to state and local governments.

title: United States v. Miller
publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
description: An early decision on regulated weapons and militia service; read alongside Heller and later decisions.

title: Caetano v. Massachusetts
publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
description: The Court addresses a stun-gun prohibition and the treatment of arms not in existence at the founding.

title: New York State Rifle & Pistol Association v. Bruen
publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
description: Public carry licensing and the text-and-tradition approach to Second Amendment challenges; read with Rahimi.

title: United States v. Rahimi
publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
description: Firearm restrictions involving domestic-violence restraining orders and the use of historical analogies after Bruen.

title: The Second Amendment at the Supreme Court: Challenges to Federal Gun Laws
description: An August 2025 overview of Second Amendment challenges to federal firearm restrictions.

title: Courts Disagree as to Whether the Federal Felon-in-Possession Firearm Prohibition Violates the Second Amendment
description: Explains the appellate disagreement over possession by people with felony convictions as of May 2024, before Rahimi.

title: The Second Amendment at the Supreme Court: New York State Rifle & Pistol Ass’n v. Bruen
description: A concise contemporary explanation of Bruen and its implications for firearm legislation.

title: Post-Heller Second Amendment Jurisprudence
description: A detailed pre-Bruen survey of firearms litigation; its earlier scrutiny framework was later rejected in Bruen.

title: Federal Firearms Laws: Overview and Selected Legal Issues for the 116th Congress
description: Statutory context for constitutional firearms disputes, describing the federal framework as of 2019 rather than current compliance advice.

title: A Second Amendment Right to Sell Firearms? The Ninth Circuit, Sitting En Banc, Weighs In.
description: A pre-Bruen analysis of commercial firearms sales and the constitutional distinction between sellers and purchasers.

title: Enforcement of Public Carry Restrictions: Texas as a Case Study
description: Examines evidence about enforcement of public-carry laws and its use in Second Amendment interpretation.

title: Tribes, Firearm Regulation, and the Public Square
description: A pre-Bruen scholarly examination of tribal firearm regulation, self-defense, and sensitive places.

title: Can the Government Prohibit 18-Year-Olds from Purchasing Firearms?
description: A pre-Bruen discussion of firearm purchase age restrictions and a Florida challenge; read as an account of the litigation at publication.
